source: Source: Audemars Piguet; Watches by SJX

slides.label: Look closer
slides.headline: The shiny parts
slides.body: The polished bezel and middle links aren't titanium. They're bulk metallic glass.

slides.label: Why glass?
slides.headline: Frozen in a jumble
slides.body: It's cooled so fast its atoms freeze in a jumble, like glass, not neat rows.

slides.label: And the colour
slides.headline: Finished in red
slides.body: AP paired the metal glass with a dial that fades from red to almost black.
